profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Java Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the retail, insurance, and financial industry. Skilled in SOA , MVC Framework, Spring Framework, Databases, Jenkins, and Java. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer and Information Sciences, General from Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Schuylkill.

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Lead development of multiple new applications to the Finigree.com platform. Worked and communicated directly with business partners such as LosFusion. Managed code reviews, development estimate timeline and requirements gathering. Mentored and helped the new offshore development team to business coding standards and best practices.

Accomplishments: Completed home and pushed home loans application to production ensuring company was paid for services rendered. Stood up a new offshore team, showcasing knowledge in front and backend development. When the old jenkins server failed, the whole team got together over the course of 2 months of all nighters to fix the server and still deploy code within the defined delivery date. Moving program out of beta to production status.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · Vue.js · Spring Boot · Java Development · Jira · SQL

positions.title: Contracted Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:Responsible for the management and creation of new reporting pages and workflow. Worked to prop up and manage multiple database instances. Became adept at Angular4 in order to fix broken logic, pipeline connections, and workflows throughout the company in order to get older systems running.

Accomplishments: Updated reporting system to allow users to perform batch outputs. Fixed issues with Angular4 and Java integration preventing a bundle of applications from deploying to production. This allowed management and shareholders to be able to add projects to the roadmap without wasting time and resources. Took charge of communicating updates with management for my team. Showcasing ability to translate technical details into actionable tasks allowing shareholders to have a deeper understanding of work being completed.

positions.title: Sr Java Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Developed multiple financial service applications and updates. Backend utilized Java and Spring Framework, managed through Maven and Jenkins. Frontend apps built with Webpack, employing AngularJs or Vue.js as needed. Managed tickets, documents, and guides in Jira. Also, served as a Team Lead, liaising with project managers, onboarding new team members, and overseeing ticket distribution to junior developers.

Accomplishments: Introduced Agile-Kanban Methodology in Jira ticket management, instilling confidence in upper management regarding team productivity. Accomplished the e-Signature application. Established backend development standards, including consistent use of ResponseEntity for frontend communication and handling exceptions with try-catch blocks. Progressed towards the goal of streamlining documentation and services for banks, realtors, and buyers.

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Title: Contracted Fullstack Software Engineer, Sr Software Engineer 
●	Responsibilities: Brought in under contract to complete multiple long-standing projects for the company. Such as updating item personalization printing screens from old green and black screens requiring commands to be entered like a Command Line Interface. To instead have an internal website application that was able to manage all commands through button clicks, drops downs, and simple forms. This greatly benefited the company and the personalization team by minimizing the number of hours required for training a team member. Furthermore, I was also assigned to the PIM (Product Information Management) team. In which I assisted with developing and managing an ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) application built using Java and Spring Data to handle persisting data changes and updates made through PIM application to Oracle database. 
●	Accomplishments: Completed critical longstanding projects solo such as creating an Earnings Forecast application based on the sales history of items purchased within different catalogs. The application saved the company hundreds and thousands of dollars because the original process was a manual data input using post-it notes on a black board to handle visualization of data. 
●	Technology: Java, Spring, Maven, Struts, Swift, Html 5, DB2, Oracle, and MySql databases, Oracle Web Application Server, Oracle Jrockit and Mission Control, SVN Repository, Docker, Rest API, REACT, ElasticSearch

company.name: Oriental Trading Company, A Berkshire Hathaway Company

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Companies: Woodman Life Insurance, Oriental Trading Company
●	Titles: Contracted Fullstack Software Engineer, Sr Software Engineer 
●	Responsibilities: Completing an abandoned customer loyalty program built using struts 1.0. Thanks to communication skills, being open to learning and a willingness to take on extra tasks. My contract was renewed for multiple years. During that time, I became a core developer for the internal software development team where I was placed in charge of several different projects ranging from bug fixes to a complete redesign of the C.O.M.E.T application. My second contract took me to Woodman Life Insurance where I expanded my development tool by being a part of a small team dedicated to the completion of a single project.
●	Accomplishments: Was chosen to be part of a small team to architect and construct an upgrade to internal custom service application from a Swing & EJB 2.0 service. To Restful micro services built using Spring Framework. This project was crucial because the legacy code became too much to maintained and required days of work and research to complete. 
●	Technology: Spring Framework, Java, HTML 5, Maven, Gradle, SVN Repository, DB2 and MySql databases. Hibernate, CSS, EMR
